en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, formal dining hall with two rows of tables covered with white tablecloths, set with plates, cups, and bread rolls. Vases with flowers stand on the tables, and a carpeted runner leads toward the far wall, where a crucifix, small religious pictures, and double doors are visible. The room has tall windows along one side and simple hanging lamps from the ceiling. Handwritten-style text at the bottom of the image identifies the location. The reverse side has standard postcard address lines and printed Hungarian text, including a publisher imprint and a commemorative seal.
